title: User Statement
content:
Accurate information

I confirm that the information I provide about myself, my contact details and my delivery details is accurate and up to date.

I will update details that change and will not use another person's information without permission.

Lawful use

I will use the service only for lawful purposes and will follow the rules that apply to the products and services I request.

I will not use the service to mislead others, commit fraud or avoid lawful requirements.

Respecting others

I will respect the rights of other users, sellers, carriers and rights holders.

I will not submit content or requests that infringe copyright, trademark, privacy or other rights.

Account responsibility

I will keep my account credentials private and will take reasonable care to protect my account.

I will promptly report suspected or unauthorized access to my account.
excerpt: A short statement of how I agree to use the service.
